summary: Backend-only testing of new ERP integration (X-API-Key) endpoints + license options (annual/semi-annual). Created /app/backend/tests/test_erp.py with 21 tests covering: GET/POST /api/company/api-key (get + regenerate, rotation invalidates old key, role gate), X-API-Key auth on /api/erp/* (missing header=401, invalid key=401, deactivated company=403), GET /api/erp/ping happy path, POST /api/erp/products/bulk create-then-upsert-by-external_id (verified created=2/updated=0 first pass, created=0/updated=2 second pass with values actually updated in GET /api/erp/products), GET /api/erp/orders with and without status=placed filter, PATCH /api/erp/orders/{id}/status update (+ 404 on unknown id), license_days=365 (annual) at company creation, license renewal add_days=180 and add_days=365. Regression: existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still 29/29 PASS. Total: 50/50 tests passed.

minor.issue: Uses Mongo projection {"_id": 0, "api_key": 1} which mixes inclusion and exclusion. It works because MongoDB tolerates the _id exclusion with inclusions, but it's better style to use only {"api_key": 1} (Mongo will implicitly return _id, then rely on returning just {'api_key': ...}). Not a bug — response is correct.
Products without external_id are always inserted (no dedupe possible) — expected per spec, but consider validating name uniqueness or documenting to callers.

License expiration check inside erp_company() silently ignores unparseable license_expires_at (bare except: pass). If a bad ISO string sneaks in, the request passes; low risk since all writes use isoformat().

action_items: None blocking. Optional: tighten projection in GET /api/company/api-key to remove _id exclusion + inclusion mix (cosmetic).
Optional: expose /api/erp/products/bulk response with per-item status (created/updated flag) for easier ERP-side reconciliation.
critical_code_review_comments: erp_company() correctly enforces 401 (missing header), 401 (invalid key), 403 (deactivated), 403 (expired license). Order of checks is safe.
POST /api/company/api-key/regenerate rotates key atomically via $set; old key immediately fails auth on /erp/* — verified.

erp_bulk_products upsert path is correct: matches on (company_id, external_id) then updates by id; if no external_id or no match, inserts a new doc with new uuid. Compound index products(company_id, external_id) is created on startup — good for scale.
license_days is a plain int on CompanyCreate (default 30). 30/90/180/365 all accepted (no validation of allowed values). Consider a Literal[30, 90, 180, 365] if you want to lock it to the four plans.
erp_company license-expiration bare 'except Exception: pass' would silently allow bad ISO strings; consider treating parse-fail as invalid.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed companies (2), owner users (2), a customer, external-id products (2 upserted), and 1 order. All cleaned up in test_cleanup_delete_erp_companies which cascades users/products; the regression suite also self-cleans its own artifacts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two independent suites: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (core auth/CRUD, 29 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_erp.py (ERP + api-key + license options, 21 tests). Both idempotent and self-cleaning. Run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Super admin: admin@delivery.com / Admin@12345.
rca_of_issue: No issues found — all new ERP endpoints and license options behave per spec, including negative auth cases and upsert semantics.
